tests.name: an idle session is not compacted while its cache has time left, and is compacted once it is a margin from expiring
tests.why: the plugin's timing on the world; the host's compaction on the model is the law 'a compaction asked with a reason…'

tests.name: the idle compaction is recorded as automatic
tests.why: the host records the reason asked: the law 'a compaction asked with a reason…'

tests.name: a host without a compaction reason records the idle compaction as manual
tests.why: a host older than the fork's compaction reason; the world runs it with its reason off

tests.name: with copies of the plugin for other directories on the host, the idle session is compacted once, by its own directory's
tests.why: real too: that the host starts a copy of a config plugin for each Location it opens is no law yet

tests.name: with background compaction on, the idle compaction swaps in the summary the host held, and asks the model for none
tests.why: real too: the host's held background summary is no law yet

tests.name: a session idle behind a background shell that outlives its cache is compacted a margin from expiry, before the shell's notice wakes it
tests.why: real too: the host's background shells and their notice are no law yet

tests.name: an alarm wakes the idle session, a notice waits for the next turn, a monitor wakes on its match, a cancel holds, and a reload fires once
tests.why: real too: what the TUI draws (the ◈ rows, the dock) waits for sim-tui, and a real plugin reload is no law yet

tests.name: an alarm due while no server ran fires when one starts, and says it went late
tests.why: real too: the late ◈ row waits for sim-tui, and a real server restart is no law yet

tests.name: without the pool, the same refusal ends the run: the host does not retry a plan limit
tests.why: real too while the real file stays: the HTTP, retry and refused laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55, but the parity check reads every manifest file, so the real file leaves with a check that allows a deleted one (sim-tui)

tests.name: the first login's plan-limit 429 holds it, and the run goes out on the second
tests.why: real too while the real file stays: the HTTP, retry, refused and integration laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55, but the parity check reads every manifest file, so the real file leaves with a check that allows a deleted one (sim-tui)

tests.name: a Codex credit is claimed by itself once; a Claude grant only on the owner's yes, with a no and a lifted hold claiming nothing
tests.why: real too: a ChatGPT login's metadata (its accountID) through integration.connection.resolve is no host law yet; the backend is under sim/chatgpt-laws.ts

tests.name: a weekly reset is offered on the fleet's demand early in the week and claimed on a yes; a Fable reset about to expire unused is claimed on its own, gives Fable's part of the week back, and the owner is told
tests.why: real too while the Codex name keeps the real file: the RPC and integration laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55 and a provider law covers the claim endpoint

tests.name: one spent week with two weekly resets about to expire spends one: the reading after it shows the week back, so the second is kept
tests.why: real too while the Codex name keeps the real file: the RPC and integration laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55 and a provider law covers the claim endpoint

tests.name: the store source refreshes at Claude Code's token endpoint
a 429's log line names who limited the request, and never more than the error's words
lists the accounts the store owns by label, and says why it leaves the rest alone
tests.why: listing a directory is the files laws' (mods/pool/store/files-laws.ts), on the disk and the memory slots alike

tests.name: serves each slot's own token, read again for every request
a stale token is refreshed once and written back in the store's exact shape, mode 0600
tests.why: real too: the slot file's mode 0600 is the disk's, and no files law reads a mode

tests.name: two processes refreshing the same stale slot at once make one refresh call
tests.why: real too: two OS processes on one SQLite lock; the files law holds the lock's one holder within a process only

tests.name: in one process too, concurrent requests for a stale slot share one refresh
a token another process refreshed while the pool waited for its lock is read again, not refreshed again
tests.why: the lock's one holder and the poll's give-up are the files laws'

tests.name: another process, waiting for the lock while the pool refreshes, reads the pool's write and writes nothing
tests.why: the lock's one holder and a whole write are the files laws'

tests.name: a refresh the endpoint could not answer writes nothing and may be tried again
a rate-limited refresh pauses every account of the store until retry-after
a refresh the endpoint refused writes nothing and asks for a new sign-in
a refresh whose write failed is held, and written later only over the login it replaced
tests.why: real too: a write the disk refuses (a read-only directory) leaving the file as it was is no files law yet

tests.name: a held refresh is dropped when another process wrote another login meanwhile
tests.why: real too: a write the disk refuses leaving the file as it was is no files law yet

tests.name: a token the provider rejected is refreshed next time, only while the store still holds it
gives up on a lock another process holds too long, with a time to try again
tests.why: the give-up with a time to try again is the files law 'a lock held through every poll gives up busy', on the disk too

tests.name: registers with the registry the auth plugin reads, and leaves it on dispose
the turn goes out on the store slot the pool picked, and fails over to the next store slot
tests.why: real too: the slot file's mode 0600 is the disk's, and no files law reads a mode (the HTTP, retry, refused and provider laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55)

tests.name: the turn completes on the second account, with no error row
tests.why: real too: OpenCode's log file through the plugin's loggers is no law yet (the HTTP, retry and refused laws kept on real OpenCode at 2b837b55)
